shots.name: The Guessing Game
shots.visual: A student holds a card with 'Profit Calc' on it, looking confused between two signs labeled 'B.Com' and 'BBA'.

shots.name: The Reveal
shots.visual: The student taps the question mark on the card, revealing it as an empty space.
shots.dialogue: Stop. There is no official source here linking this task to either degree. You cannot classify a program without one.

shots.name: The Better Question
shots.visual: Student looks directly at the camera, holding the card up.
shots.dialogue: Don’t guess. Ask: What official source links this task to this specific degree?
